note: The Inn's pool above the Ingling dam (Kraftwerk Passau-Ingling, weir way 273300967), the forebay from the weir (project row ~3180) to the map's south edge (row 3456; west of project col 0, row 3712, where the pool ends by row ~3600). OSM's outline (outer way 160959413) runs ~11 km up the Inn; the extract keeps only its nodes near the map, so its ring stops open at both banks south of the map's edge (827843,5386498 and 827672,5386434, EPSG:25832, with the map to row 3712) and polygonized to nothing. The rivers from the terrain model took most of the pool, but DGM1 ramps across the weir (it has the surfaces on either side): 150 m above the weir a dry pit of 293-302 m stood under the 302.95 m pool. Closed off the map (`close`) at the pool's level, as scripts/map.json's stretch gives it (302.95 m, the plant's operating level). Its banks are natural (dikes, riprap, the Austrian forest), so no wall faces.
